name: AgencyAnalytics
description_en:
AgencyAnalytics brings agency client data into dashboards, recurring reports and a branded portal. Its current platform connects marketing sources and supports custom calculations, permissions and AgencyAI; Rank Tracker and AI Tracker are separately priced add-ons. A Client is a reporting scope, so one commercial customer may require several Clients.

The useful evaluation is an actual client reporting cycle: connect the right accounts, inspect freshness, validate formulas as the intended user, review a scheduled report and check delivery. Traditional ranking and AI-answer observations remain scoped measurements; neither a chart nor an assistant narrative establishes business impact. This is public-documentation research, with no connected accounts or sent reports.
description_zh:
AgencyAnalytics 将机构客户数据集中到仪表盘、定期报告及品牌门户。当前平台连接营销数据源，支持自定义计算、权限及 AgencyAI；Rank Tracker 和 AI Tracker 是另行计费的附加项。Client 是报告范围，因此一个商业客户可能需要多个 Client。

适合评估的是一个真实客户报告周期：连接正确账户、查时效、以目标用户验证公式、审定时报告并检查投递。传统排名及 AI 回答观察都是限定范围的测量，图表或代理叙述不能确定业务影响。本条依据公开文档，未连接账户或发送报告。

core_features.explanation_en: Dashboards and reports organize the selected client data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 仪表盘及报告组织所选客户数据。

core_features.explanation_en: A scheduled instance waits for review when approval is enabled.
core_features.explanation_zh: 开启审批时，定时实例等待审阅。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose source metrics and account filters rather than pasting plain text.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择源指标及账户筛选，不能直接粘贴普通文本。

core_features.explanation_en: Warehoused connections distinguish loading, failed fetches and stale data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 仓储连接区分加载、抓取失败及过旧数据。

en: Build a client report with explicit account selection and source freshness.
Review a recurring report before delivery using the intended client permissions.
Monitor a fixed SEO/AI query panel alongside independently measured campaign results.
zh: 按明确账户选择及源时效制作客户报告。
按目标客户权限审定期报告后投递。
在独立实测营销结果旁监控固定 SEO／AI 查询面板。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: USD annual cards show Core $20/client/month, AI Tracker $20.83/month per 250 credits, and Rank Tracker $41.67/month per 500 keywords, all billed annually. No monthly rate or annual total derived. Core lists unlimited staff, sources, reports and dashboards; 25+ Clients use volume quotes. Fourteen-day no-card core trial and thirty-day money-back offer; annual requires a year commitment. Add-on help separately quotes $25/250 AI credits without the annual-card context. Its trial auto-bills unless canceled, credits expire monthly. Six billing currencies and regional variations; tax not verified. No normalized price.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: USD 年付卡列 Core 每 Client 每月 $20，AI Tracker 每 250 积分每月 $20.83，Rank Tracker 每 500 关键词每月 $41.67，均按年收款，不推月付价或年总额。Core 列不限 Staff、源、报告及仪表盘，25+ Client 询量价。主产品十四天免卡试用、三十天退款承诺，年付须一年。附加项帮助另列 $25／250 AI 积分，未带年付卡语境，其试用未取消自动计费，积分每月到期。六种计费币种且地区可异，税未核，不设标准化价。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Client setup and cloning require a data-scope check
sections.title_zh: Client 设置及克隆需要核数据范围
sections.en: A Client can represent a website, subdomain, path or supported public page. Its timezone controls data display and report sending; All Time begins at Client Start Date. Cloning can carry reports, dashboards, user access and markup, while sources must be connected for the new Client. Editorial onboarding: inspect inherited access before adding real data, choose the reporting timezone deliberately and check the date range. Reusing a template does not establish that the destination accounts, access or history are correct.
sections.zh: Client 可代表网站、子域、路径或支持的公开页，时区控制数据显示及报告发送，All Time 从 Client Start Date 开始。克隆可带报告、仪表盘、用户访问及加价设置，新 Client 需连接数据源。编辑入门：加真实数据前检查继承访问，明确选择报告时区并核日期。复用模板不能确定目标账户、访问或历史正确。

sections.title_en: Connected accounts are selected rather than automatically pooled
sections.title_zh: 连接账户需选择，不自动合并
sections.en: The current Core guide permits up to ten accounts/pages for integrations supporting multiple accounts within one Client. Connect an initial source before adding another. A prebuilt dashboard can switch accounts; a custom widget selects its account in the Data tab. This is not a promise that every integration supports ten accounts or that all accounts aggregate automatically. Editorial multi-brand report: label the selected property visibly and test a representative widget against that property before expanding the panel. The pricing FAQ still uses older Agency/Agency Pro labels, so verify current account entitlements.
sections.zh: 当前 Core 指南对支持多账户的集成，允许一个 Client 最多十个账户／页面；先连接首源再追加。预置仪表盘可切账户，自定义组件在 Data 选账户。这不代表每种集成都支持十个或全部自动汇总。编辑多品牌报告：明显标所选属性，扩展前用代表组件与该属性核对。价格 FAQ 仍用旧 Agency／Agency Pro 名称，需核当前账户权益。

sections.title_en: A Client user is not necessarily read-only
sections.en: Client Access, User Permissions and Dashboard Visibility control different things. Client users can receive permitted editing or connection actions, but cannot receive billing and certain account administration rights. Staff billing access can be separately granted. Email recipients need no login; a custom dashboard requires a Client login. Staff and Client types cannot be directly converted according to the guide. Editorial invitation: inspect all three controls, use the branded login URL and verify the intended view. An unlimited staff count does not define access boundaries; deleting a Client does not delete its users.
sections.zh: Client Access、User Permissions 及 Dashboard Visibility 各控不同范围。Client 用户可获允许的编辑或连接操作，但不能获账单及特定账户管理权；Staff 账单权另授。邮件收件人无需登录，自定义仪表盘需 Client 登录。指南称 Staff 与 Client 类型不能直接转换。编辑邀请：核三项控制、使用品牌登录 URL 并查目标视图。不限 Staff 数不定义访问边界，删除 Client 不会删除其用户。

sections.title_en: Loading, failed and stale data need different responses
sections.title_zh: 加载、失败及过旧数据需要不同处理
sections.en: Warehousing begins after a supported connection. The guide estimates one to two days for initialization, then four to fourteen days for historical backfill. History differs by integration and metric: a one-day entry is a refreshed snapshot, not daily history. The clock tooltip separates Still Loading, Stopped after a failed fetch, and Stale after at least three days without an update even when nothing failed. Its retry time is approximate and in browser-local time. Editorial report review: inspect available dates and source freshness before treating an empty period as zero performance or promising an exact retry deadline.
sections.zh: 支持的连接建成后开始仓储，指南估首次初始化一至两天，再用四至十四天回填历史。历史依集成及指标不同，一天条目是刷新快照，不是逐日历史。时钟提示区分 Still Loading、抓取失败的 Stopped，以及即使没失败、至少三天未更新的 Stale。重试时间是估计，按浏览器本地时区。编辑报告检查：将空区间解释为零表现或承诺准确重试前，查可用日期及源时效。

sections.title_en: Reconnect the authorization actually shared by the affected Clients
sections.title_zh: 重连受影响 Client 实际共享的授权
sections.en: OAuth reconnection at Data Sources can restore all Clients under the same authorization. API-key/manual sources instead require per-Client removal and reconnection. A brief disconnection does not automatically erase warehouse history; Simpli.fi can need extra catch-up time. For a discrepancy, compare the exact native metric, dates and account rather than similar labels such as Clicks and Link Clicks. The troubleshooting guide says missing data can later reappear in live web reports already emailed during an outage. Editorial handoff: record the observed time and data state; a delivered web link is not necessarily a frozen historical artifact.
sections.zh: Data Sources 重连 OAuth 可恢复同一授权下全部 Client；API key／手动源则逐 Client 移除再连接。短暂断开不自动清除仓储历史，Simpli.fi 可能需额外追赶。差异需比准确原生指标、日期及账户，不能将 Clicks 与 Link Clicks 等相近标签视同。故障指南说中断时已邮件发送的实时网页报告，缺失数据之后可重新出现。编辑交接：记录观察时刻及数据状态，投递网页链接不一定是冻结历史产物。

sections.title_en: Validate formulas through the intended client view
sections.title_zh: 通过目标客户视图验证公式
sections.en: Custom Metrics use selected metric tokens, operators and account/property filters. They support at most fifteen input metrics, cannot nest another custom metric, and require historical-capable inputs; Rank Tracker and several other integrations are unsupported. Google Sheets requires the correct sheet, tab, date column and aggregator. Cloning retains the original formula references: an Admin with access to both Clients may see data while the destination Client user sees an error. Editorial formula check: review source filters and the selected user view after cloning. A cross-platform arithmetic result alone does not establish deduplicated conversions or comparable currencies.
sections.zh: Custom Metrics 使用选取的指标 token、运算符及账户／属性筛选。最多十五个输入，不能嵌套另一自定义指标，输入须支持历史；Rank Tracker 等集成不支持。Google Sheets 需正确表格、标签页、日期列及聚合器。克隆保留原公式引用，能访问两个 Client 的 Admin 可见数据，目标 Client 用户却可能报错。编辑公式核查：克隆后审源筛选及目标用户视图。跨平台算术本身不能确定转化去重或币种可比。

sections.title_en: Approval waits until the scheduled instance is reviewed
sections.title_zh: 审批等待对应定时实例被审阅
sections.en: A schedule selects data range, recipients, cadence and optional dynamic dates separately. Require Approval produces an in-app review notification at the scheduled send time; the reviewer may edit the report and email, then Approve and Send sends immediately. Pending instances can be reviewed or rejected from Awaiting Approval. Turning Schedule Active off pauses delivery. Editorial missed-email diagnosis: check active schedule, pending approval and activity status before asking recipients to inspect spam. Autosaved report design does not prove sending, and a scheduled time with approval enabled is not an unconditional delivery promise.
sections.zh: 计划分别选数据区间、收件人、周期及可选动态日期。Require Approval 在计划发送时产生应用内审阅通知，审阅者可改报告及邮件，再用 Approve and Send 立即发送。Awaiting Approval 中可审或拒待审实例，关闭 Schedule Active 暂停投递。编辑未收邮件诊断：先查计划启用、待审批及活动状态，再让收件人查垃圾箱。设计自动保存不能证明发送，开启审批的计划时间也不是无条件投递承诺。

sections.title_en: Rank changes depend on the tracked panel and date interval
sections.title_zh: 排名变化取决于跟踪面板及日期间隔
sections.en: The colored distribution counts explicitly tracked keywords within the top hundred, not every query where the website ranks. The guide specifies weekly keyword updates. Change compares endpoints; Automatic uses monthly logic beyond thirty-one days, which can select the first day of the starting month rather than the selected start date. Ignore Lost/Found changes can exclude those jumps from change metrics while preserving their visibility. Newly enabled engines do not retroactively create historical observations. Editorial SEO review: retain date interval, engine, location and settings with the chart before explaining a movement; summed position changes are not traffic or revenue.
sections.zh: 颜色分布统计明确跟踪且前百的词，不是网站全部排名查询。指南列关键词周更。变化比较端点，Automatic 超三十一天用月逻辑，可采用起始月首日而非所选开始日。Ignore Lost/Found 可从变化指标排除这些跳变，仍保留发现／丢失展示。新增启用引擎不会追溯生成历史观察。编辑 SEO 检查：解释变化前随图保留间隔、引擎、位置及设置；排名位次变化之和不是流量或收入。

sections.title_en: AI monitoring has a separate trial and recurring credit budget
sections.title_zh: AI 监控有独立试用及持续积分预算
sections.en: AI Tracker uses backend queries, not a personalized user session. Its six listed platforms and locations multiply usage; one query/platform/location costs one credit per weekly check, and the guide budgets four checks monthly. Unused credits expire. Its fourteen-day, 250-credit add-on trial automatically bills unless canceled, unlike the core no-card trial. Opportunities beta covers linked appearances in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews; ChatGPT discovery is US-based and capped at one hundred results per Client. Editorial interpretation: preserve the actual answer and panel settings, compare repeated observations, and separate mentions, citations and measured referrals. A single empty answer does not establish global absence.
sections.zh: AI Tracker 用后端查询，不是个性化用户会话。列出的六个平台及位置倍增用量，一个查询／平台／位置每次周检一积分，指南按每月四检预算；未用积分到期失效。十四天、250 积分的附加项试用未取消会自动计费，与主产品免卡试用不同。Opportunities beta 覆盖 ChatGPT 及 Google AI Overviews 的带链接出现，ChatGPT 发现基于美国，每 Client 最多一百结果。编辑解读：保留真实回答及面板设置，比多次观察，分别报告提及、引用及实测引荐。单次空回答不能确定全球缺席。

sections.title_en: MCP can change agency account objects
sections.title_zh: MCP 可以修改机构账户对象
sections.en: The current MCP guide restricts connections to Admin/Staff permissions, one Client per connection and one hundred requests per minute. October 14 write tools include client changes, invitations, permissions and custom metrics; editing a global metric affects dashboards, goals and reports that use it. Paid additions and credit-consuming actions show costs first, with extra-client approval restricted to billing-authorized users. External source pulling remains distinct from changing AgencyAnalytics objects. Editorial assistant use: establish the Client and requested action explicitly, review the affected object before a write and retain the source data behind a narrative. No MCP connection or write was executed here.
sections.zh: 当前 MCP 指南限定 Admin／Staff 权限，每连接一个 Client，每分钟一百请求。十月十四日写工具含 Client 变更、邀请、权限及自定义指标，编辑全局指标影响使用它的仪表盘、目标及报告。付费增加及耗积分操作先展示成本，额外 Client 需有账单权限者批准。读取外部源不同于修改 AgencyAnalytics 对象。编辑代理使用：明确 Client 及请求动作，写前审受影响对象，并保留叙述的源数据。本研究未连接或写 MCP。

sections.title_en: Deleting a Client and canceling the account have different clocks
sections.title_zh: 删除 Client 与取消账户有不同时间线
sections.en: Client deletion does not reduce paid capacity automatically. The guide allows full data restoration in the first thirty days, then marks warehouse data for deletion and purges it thirty days later; restoration after the initial window starts warehouse/time-series collection afresh. Restoring a billable Client can incur a prorated charge. Account cancellation is Admin-only, stops renewal and preserves access through the paid term; afterward clients lose reports/dashboard access. Its guide states permanent account-data deletion after three months and no midterm prorated refund. Editorial exit: export required records and verify capacity, term and deletion dates separately.
sections.zh: 删除 Client 不自动减少付费容量。指南说前三十天可完整恢复数据，之后标记仓储数据删除，再三十天永久清除；初始窗口后恢复会重新开始仓储／时间序列采集，恢复可计费 Client 可产生按比例费用。账户取消仅 Admin 可做，停止续订并保留已付期访问，之后客户失去报告／仪表盘访问。取消指南列三个月后永久删除账户数据，期中取消不按比例退款。编辑退出：导所需记录，并分别核容量、期限及删除日期。

seo.title_en: AgencyAnalytics: client reports, approval and add-on limits
seo.title_zh: AgencyAnalytics：客户报告、审批及附加项限制
seo.description_en: Evaluate AgencyAnalytics client scope, source freshness, formulas, report delivery and separate SEO/AI add-ons.
seo.description_zh: 核 AgencyAnalytics 客户范围、源时效、公式、报告投递及独立 SEO／AI 附加项。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate AgencyAnalytics client reporting workflow and add-on costs
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Current Core labels differ from older Agency/Agency Pro pricing FAQ; actual regional entitlements, monthly rate, tax and exact account charges not operated.
research_gaps.zh: 当前 Core 名称与旧 Agency／Agency Pro 价格 FAQ 不同，真实地区权益、月付价、税及准确账户收费未操作。

research_gaps.en: Full per-integration metrics, AI market coverage, external MCP beta restrictions, report-link security, interface languages and source-code licence not comprehensively verified.
research_gaps.zh: 各集成完整指标、AI 市场覆盖、外部 MCP beta 限制、报告链接安全、界面语言及源码许可未全面核。

research_gaps.en: No account creation, source authorization, add-on trial, prompt/rank query, invitation, metric mutation, cancellation, export or email executed; accuracy and business results unmeasured.
research_gaps.zh: 未创建账户、授权源、启附加试用、查询提示词／排名、邀请、改指标、取消、导出或邮件，准确率及业务结果未测。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
